rules.title: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance (Chapter 260) - small property exemption
rules.requirement: Jersey City's Rent Control Ordinance, Chapter 260 of the Municipal Code, regulates rents and is administered by the Office of Landlord Tenant Relations. All 1-4 unit properties are exempt from rent control.
rules.coverage_text: Rental properties in Jersey City other than 1-4 unit properties; other exemptions under the ordinance may be requested through a Rent Control Exemption Request.
rules.exemptions: All 1-4 unit properties are exempt from rent control; the ordinance provides certain other exemptions that an owner may request if it meets the criteria.
rules.citation: Rent Control Ordinance, Chapter 260 of the Jersey City Municipal Code
rules.quoted_span: (Please Note: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control)
